title: Mock both useBooleanFlagValue and useFlag when testing OpenFeature-gated components
answers: Why does my feature-flag-gated test not react to the mocked flag value?
How do I mock @openfeature/react-sdk in Jest tests
useFlag mock isn't working in my component test
Flag-controlled UI section not appearing/disappearing in tests
body:
Symptom: a Jest test mocks @openfeature/react-sdk's useBooleanFlagValue but a component controlled by a generated hook (useFlagGrafana*) still renders with the wrong default, because that hook internally calls useFlag, not useBooleanFlagValue.
Root cause: generated per-flag hooks in packages/grafana-runtime/src/internal/openFeature/openfeature.gen.ts (e.g. useFlagGrafanaLogDetailsDisplayedFieldControls) call useFlag, while legacy call sites use useBooleanFlagValue directly - both exist in the same codebase.
Fix pattern: when jest.mock('@openfeature/react-sdk', ...), mock both useBooleanFlagValue and useFlag (returning {value: ...}) with jest.requireActual spread in, and drive both from the same flags map in a setBooleanFlags helper so either call style is controllable.
Constraints: applies to any test touching a component that reads flags via @grafana/runtime/internal generated hooks; not needed if the component only ever calls useBooleanFlagValue directly.
applies: Jest tests for React components that read OpenFeature flags via @grafana/runtime/internal generated hooks or useBooleanFlagValue

search: Testing OpenFeature-gated components requires mocking both useBooleanFlagValue and useFlag from @openfeature/react-sdk with a shared flags map. Generated per-flag hooks in packages/grafana-runtime/src/internal/openFeature/openfeature.gen.ts (e.g. useFlagGrafanaLogDetailsDisplayedFieldControls) call useFlag internally, while some call sites use useBooleanFlagValue directly; mocking only one causes the component to render with wrong defaults. Apply jest.mock with jest.requireActual spread and a setBooleanFlags helper to drive both call styles from the same state. This applies to Jest tests for React components reading flags via @grafana/runtime/internal generated hooks or useBooleanFlagValue; not needed if the component only calls useBooleanFlagValue directly. See public/app/features/logs/components/panel/LogLineDetails.test.tsx for pattern.
